description: Release skip classification. Every skipped surefire identity must match exactly one rule. allowed_when_absent names an input the runner may declare absent (--capabilities name=false); null means the test is opt-in and its skip is always optional. Categories gl-context and optional-fixture are REQUIRED whenever the runner declares that input present. See tools/testing/classify_surefire_skips.py.

inputs.gl: an OpenGL 4.1 offscreen context via GLFW (release runner: required, Xvfb or real display)
inputs.s3k_observations: S3K request observations sidecar property (optional measurement input)
inputs.s1_bizhawk_reference: local deterministic Sonic 1 BizHawk reference capture (optional measurement input)
inputs.audio_reference_files: AudioReferenceGenerator output for AudioRegressionTest (optional measurement input)
inputs.s3k_gumball_roundtrip: Recorded three-segment S3K AIZ gumball round-trip fixture at src/test/resources/traces/s3k/runs/s3k-aiz-gumball-roundtrip; explicitly declare absent only after checking the directory is absent.
inputs.s3k_pachinko_roundtrip: Recorded three-segment S3K AIZ pachinko round-trip fixture at src/test/resources/traces/s3k/runs/s3k-aiz-pachinko-roundtrip; explicitly declare absent only after checking the directory is absent.
inputs.soniccd_media: -Dsoniccd.media.root directory holding the user's Sonic CD disc images (optional user media)
inputs.soniccd_native: -Dsoniccd.native.root BizHawk Sonic CD reference captures and traces (optional measurement input; tests also look beside the media root)
inputs.soniccd_stamp_ledger: -Dsoniccd.stamp.ownerLedger native Sonic CD stamp owner ledger (optional measurement input)
